final.memo:
The Company represents a dominant digital advertising franchise that possesses one of the most powerful network effects in history, with 3.54 billion people using its platforms daily [D01]. Despite the market's focus on short-term volatility, the business remains exceptionally high-margin, generating robust cash flows from its core Family of Apps segment [D01].

Following the Q3 2025 earnings report, the market reacted with an 11% sell-off, driven by fears surrounding increased capital expenditure guidance and speculative losses in Reality Labs [D03, D05, D07]. We believe this dislocation creates an attractive entry point, as the market is mispricing the company by conflating long-term, potentially high-return AI infrastructure investments with permanent impairment of intrinsic value [D03, D05].

We have acquired our position at a 22.1x tax-normalized trailing P/E, a valuation we find compelling for a business of this quality and growth profile [D04]. With revenue growth at 26% as of Q3 2025, we project a path of double-digit annual EPS growth, assuming disciplined management of Reality Labs losses and successful monetization of AI capacity [D03, D05]. We believe a 25x terminal multiple is appropriate given the durability of the advertising moat [D03].

Our role is that of a long-term compounder, supporting management’s aggressive push into AI while maintaining vigilance on capital efficiency [D03]. The company’s $15.614 billion net cash balance sheet serves as a critical buffer, limiting downside risk should the macro or regulatory environment tighten unexpectedly [D02].

We are initiating a position today with a target size of 8% of NAV, reflecting our high conviction in the core franchise's competitive endurance [D02, D04]. We will continue to monitor the ROI of AI spending and the trajectory of Reality Labs as key indicators of continued capital allocation discipline [D03, D05].
